set_ordered_readers.schedule: each round runs both probe blocks, alternating which goes first; within a block the eight (read_op, W, R) cells follow that round's row of a Williams design; one harness process per cell; the throughput pass runs every round before the counters pass
set_ordered_readers.process_rule: a single foreign process above 100% of a CPU is judged from the runner's host guard (host-guard.json, host-activity.jsonl); this driver samples no per-process CPU. Where the workflow attaches the guard's record, it is this artifact's provenance.host_guard (METHODOLOGY.md §36.12 item 4); this driver neither writes nor removes that key

form_coverage.rule: a hotspot cell with writers whose rows include one ending with full_expanse = 0 is void for any statement about form coverage (METHODOLOGY.md §36.6, §36.12 item 3)
